termination_policy: The original frozen endpoint and any separately frozen native-EOS continuation are different treatments. Never overwrite old grades or merge cap endpoints into a claim of completed utility. Every non-EOS cutoff is unfinished. If no ceiling binds, label that panel-specific fact.
